values: 蓄力后挥出恐怖的一击，将期间受到的伤害加倍奉还。
Thoran charges up to launch a terrifying slash, dealing roughly double the damage he received during the charge.
进入一段时间蓄力，蓄力结束后对范围内敌人造成200% + 20% ATK伤害，并附加蓄力期间受到伤害的180%，且获得额外20%生命汲取效果。施法期间处于霸体状态。

Thoran charges up briefly before slashing at enemies within range, dealing 200% + 20% ATK damage plus 180% of the damage received during the charge. Additionally, he gains 20% Life Drain and is unaffected while casting this skill.
附加蓄力期间受到伤害的200%。
Increases the extra damage to 200% of damage received during the charge.
若技能期间被打断，则托安的灵魂会替其完成挥砍。
If interrupted, Thoran's soul will complete the slash.
附加蓄力期间受到伤害的220%。
Increases the extra damage to 220% of damage received during the charge.
附加蓄力期间受到伤害的240%。
Increases the extra damage to 240% of damage received during the charge.
吸取最高生命值敌人的一部分生命值并挪为己用。
Thoran drains a portion of the HP from the enemy with the highest HP to increase his own HP.
选择场上当前生命值最高且未被“灵魂剥夺”的敌人，吸收其18% + 1.5%当前生命值并增加等量自身生命上限，并使对方受到的伤害提升13%，直至战斗结束。本技能吸收的生命值至多不超过托安攻击力的600%。

Thoran targets the enemy with the highest HP who is not affected by Soul Plunder, draining 18% + 1.5% of their current HP to increase his max HP by the same amount. He also makes this enemy receive 13% more damage for the rest of the battle. The HP drained cannot exceed 600% of Thoran's ATK.
吸收生命值的数值提升至敌人20% + 1.5%当前生命值。
Increases drained HP to 20% + 1.5% of the enemy's current HP.
将会使对方受到的伤害提升16%，直至战斗结束。
Increases the enemy's received damage by 16% for the rest of the battle.
将会使对方受到的伤害提升17%，直至战斗结束。
Increases the enemy's received damage by 17% for the rest of the battle.
受到致命一击后可以复活一次。
Thoran resurrects once after receiving a fatal blow.
托安受到最后一击后，会在短暂延时之后复活，并恢复40% + 4% HP的生命。每场战斗至多触发1次。
Thoran, upon receiving a fatal blow, will resurrect after a brief time and recover 40% + 4% HP HP. This effect can be triggered once per battle.
触发该技能后还会获得500点能量。
Gains 500 Energy when the skill is triggered.
提高自身攻击或者技能导致的能量回复的数值，并且在未触发复活时有额外提升。
Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery, and his Energy Recovery further increases when Resurrection is not triggered.
战斗中，攻击或技能使自身能量回复的回复量提升24%,当技能“黄泉归来”未被触发时，能量的回复量额外提升6%。
Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery by 24%. His Energy Recovery is increased by an extra 6% when Resurrection is not triggered.
战斗中，攻击或技能使自身能量回复的回复量提升32%,当技能“黄泉归来”未被触发时，能量的回复量额外提升8%。
Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery by 32%. His Energy Recovery is increased by an extra 8% when Resurrection is not triggered.
战斗中，攻击或技能使自身能量回复的回复量提升40%,当技能“黄泉归来”未被触发时，能量的回复量额外提升10%。
Thoran's normal attacks and skills increase his Energy Recovery by 40%. His Energy Recovery is increased by an extra 10% when Resurrection is not triggered.
Thoran takes some damage for an ally.
战斗开始前，托安会和位于身后一格的友军签订契约，在战斗中托安将替其承受50%伤害，直至战斗结束。托安受到最后一击后该友军会牺牲85%当前生命值使托安回复150%这部分生命值，随后托安便不再替友军承受伤害。

Thoran signs a pact with the ally placed 1 tile behind him before a battle starts, agreeing to take 50% damage for them until the battle ends. When Thoran receives a fatal blow, this ally sacrifices 85% of their current HP to save and heal Thoran by 150% of this amount. After that, Thoran no longer takes damage for this ally.
契约存在期间，该友军造成伤害的25%会治疗托安。
While the pact is active, 25% of the damage dealt by this ally can heal Thoran.
友军造成伤害对托安的治疗量提升至30%。
Increases the healing amount that Thoran receives from the ally's damage dealt to 30%.
友军造成伤害对托安的治疗量提升至35%。
Increases the healing amount that Thoran receives from the ally's damage dealt to 35%.
释放终极技能时，会从敌人身上再次吸收生命值。
Thoran drains HP from the enemy again when casting Soul Retaliation.
释放终极技能时，会从所有被“灵魂剥夺”影响的敌人身上再次吸收20%当前生命值并增加等量自身生命上限。
Thoran drains another 20% of the current HP from all enemies affected by Soul Plunder when casting Soul Retaliation, increasing his max HP by the same amount.
